message:
We recently had a little scare when a storm was headed our way. As the winds picked up, we gathered in the living room with our go-bags and a few snacks, turning what could have been a stressful situation into a cozy family event. We shared stories about our favorite adventures and even played a few rounds of cards by candlelight. 🌪️

It reminded us that being prepared isn’t just about the supplies we have; it’s also about how we come together as a family. So, whether it’s creating a plan or packing your go-bags, let’s find ways to make these moments feel warm and connected. What’s your favorite way to turn a preparedness plan into a family experience?
